facts.business: Hem Holdings and Trading Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) classified as an Investment and Credit Company engaged in lending and investment activities.

guidance_or_targets.statement: RBI glide path requires NBFC-ICC to achieve net owned funds of Rs 10 crore

auditor.name: M/S. B. M. GATTANI & CO., CHARTERED ACCOUNTANTS
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding minimum net owned fund requirement: Net owned funds of Rs 1.55 crore as at 31st March 2026 against RBI requirement of Rs 5 crore by 31st March 2025 and Rs 10 crore by 31st March 2027; eventual outcome of steps proposed and RBI action on Certificate of Registration cannot be determined.

key_risks: Regulatory risk: Non-compliance with RBI minimum net owned fund requirement (Rs 1.55 crore vs required Rs 5 crore by March 2025 and Rs 10 crore by March 2027) may lead to action on Certificate of Registration
Regulatory tightening around unsecured consumer credit introducing capital implications
Dependence on external factors beyond management control affecting forward-looking statements
